summary: Quartzsea Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K/A amendment postponing its extraordinary general meeting from June 16, 2026 to 5:00 PM ET on June 18, 2026. Concurrently, the shareholder redemption deadline was extended to June 18, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET. The filing does not disclose deal terms, premium, or advisors, as it relates to a procedural adjournment ahead of a possible business combination vote. No board recommendation or investment bank is named. The event is typical SPAC operational mechanics—shareholders should monitor whether the extension signals a pending deal announcement or insufficient redemption support to close a merger. Risk-arb: focus on redemption levels and whether Nasdaq listing conditions are met.
